lines: New, huh? I'm Gus. Don't lean on my counter.
Two cocoas. Nina told me. Loudly.
Two pink lemonades. Nina told me. Loudly.
Another wobble spilled my sugar jar. Pipes, my foot.
Cider. Hot or cold. No pumpkin spice.
...Fine. I made a pumpkin spice donut. Shh.
My door squeaks. Ivy says it's charming. It's not.
Coffee. Early. Nobody talks to me. Good.
Closing soon. ...Fine. One more slice of pie.
